summary: The {{destination}} stopped answering in time for {{failures}} deliveries between {{first_time}} and {{last_time}} ("{{top_error}}"). Affected orders include {{affected}}.
likely_cause: The {{destination}} is slow, usually because it is busy or a plugin on it is taking too long. Some of these requests may have been processed even though no reply came back.
suggested_fix: Retries are safe here: every delivery carries an idempotency key, so a request that did go through is not repeated. If timeouts continue, ask the host to check the server load. Deliveries waiting in the dead letter queue right now: {{dead_count}}.
